results.description: real Cowboy/EMQX modules run under each runtime (per-call cost + wall latency)
notes: staged 4 foreign case(s) from 2 distinct source file(s)
case bstr_to_lower: N=1500000 (sys), sources=cowboy/src/cowboy_bstr.erl
case bstr_capitalize_token: N=1500000 (sys), sources=cowboy/src/cowboy_bstr.erl
case emqx_base62_encode: N=3000000 (sys), sources=emqx/apps/emqx/src/emqx_base62.erl
case emqx_base62_decode: N=3000000 (sys), sources=emqx/apps/emqx/src/emqx_base62.erl
observed stdout: bstr_to_lower=45000000 bstr_capitalize_token=45000000 emqx_base62_encode=48000000 emqx_base62_decode=33000000

method: per-call cost = (mean wall at N iterations - mean wall at 0 iterations) / N; N is per runtime so both marginals are measurable, and the fixed process startup (incl. the Rust runtime's code-path resolution) cancels out of both sides
cases: 4 ok, 0 unsupported (of 4)

results.description: a BIF-free recursive list walk on both runtimes (interpreter ns/element)
notes: staged $TMPDIR/bench-scratch-list_walk-8-2-1792097256173342734/bench_list_walk.beam (embedded source, LEN=1000, erlc=/nix/store/khp1dd3fk8476mwg62cinwvk5a17r53s-erlang-29.1.1/lib/erlang/erts-17.1/bin/erlc)
observed stdout: list_walk=N*500500=50050000000
case list_walk: N=100000 walks (sys) at LEN=1000, i.e. 100000000 elements walked

method: ns/element = (mean wall at N walks - mean wall at 0 walks) / (N * LEN) * 1e6; N is per runtime so both marginals are measurable, and the fixed process startup (incl. the Rust runtime's code-path resolution) cancels out of both sides; the module is BIF-free and builds no term
note: element count is deterministic and contention-immune; the wall-clock rows move with host load

results.description: term-copy/ETF round-trips under each runtime (per-op copy cost)
notes: staged $TMPDIR/bench-scratch-copy_bound-8-3-1792097274171598864/bench_copy_bound.beam (embedded source, per-op increment=1, erlc=/nix/store/khp1dd3fk8476mwg62cinwvk5a17r53s-erlang-29.1.1/lib/erlang/erts-17.1/bin/erlc)
case etf_roundtrip: N=1500000 (sys) copy round-trips of the 5-key payload
case ets_copy: N=2000000 (sys) copy round-trips of the 5-key payload
case send_recv: N=500000 (sys) copy round-trips of the 5-key payload
case send_recv_plain: N=1000000 (sys) copy round-trips of the 5-key payload
observed stdout: etf_roundtrip=1500000 ets_copy=2000000 send_recv=500000 send_recv_plain=1000000 (each case prints N * 1)

method: ns/op = (mean wall at N ops - mean wall at 0 ops) / N * 1e6; N is per runtime so both marginals are measurable, and the fixed process startup (incl. the Rust runtime's code-path resolution) cancels out of both sides; every case validates its copy round-trip with a bound-variable pattern
note: the op count is deterministic and contention-immune; the wall-clock rows move with host load
cases: 4 ok, 0 unsupported (of 4)

results.description: allocate-and-abandon garbage churn under each runtime (per-op GC cost)
notes: staged $TMPDIR/bench-scratch-gc_bound-8-4-1792097343074523186/bench_gc_bound.beam (embedded source, LEN=256, per-op increment=1, erlc=/nix/store/khp1dd3fk8476mwg62cinwvk5a17r53s-erlang-29.1.1/lib/erlang/erts-17.1/bin/erlc)
observed stdout: churn=N*1=200000
case churn: N=200000 churns (sys), each allocating and abandoning a 256-element list, a 256-byte binary and a 256-element tuple

method: ns/op = (mean wall at N churns - mean wall at 0 churns) / N * 1e6; N is per runtime so both marginals are measurable, and the fixed process startup (incl. the Rust runtime's code-path resolution) cancels out of both sides

note: the op count is deterministic and contention-immune; the wall-clock rows move with host load. Whether a runtime's collector actually runs during the loop is its own admission policy — this row measures the allocate-and-abandon wall time, and claims no collection count
